question: With reference to the Supreme Court's order of 21 August 2026 on recruitment to the post of Civil Judge (Junior Division), consider the following statements:
statements: It reduced the mandatory minimum Bar practice for entry-level recruitment from three years to one year.
In place of the reduced practice period, it prescribed one year of judicial-academy training and one year of structured clerkship.
The order arose out of review petitions in the *All India Judges Association* line of cases.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three are correct: Bar practice cut from three years to one, replaced by one year of judicial-academy training plus one year of clerkship, arising from review petitions in the *All India Judges Association* cases.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The Memorandum of Arrangement (MoA) on Maritime Security Cooperation signed in August 2026 was concluded between India and which country, and by whom on the foreign side?
explanation: India and Japan signed the MoA on Maritime Security Cooperation on 20 August 2026; Rajnath Singh and Japan's Defence Minister Shinjirō Koizumi signed it in New Delhi.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The 'National Report on Deep-Sea and Distant-Water Fishery Resources of the Indian Exclusive Economic Zone', released in August 2026 by the Centre for Marine Living Resources & Ecology (CMLRE), was brought out by an institution working under which one of the following Ministries?

options.text: Ministry of Fisheries, Animal Husbandry and Dairying
Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change
Ministry of Ports, Shipping and Waterways

explanation: CMLRE is an attached office of the Ministry of Earth Sciences (not the Fisheries Ministry) — a common trap.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The Mobile Phone Manufacturing Scheme (MPMS), notified in August 2026, is best described as:

options.text: A Rs 62,500 crore, five-year (FY 2026–27 to 2030–31) successor architecture to the PLI for large-scale electronics, notified by MeitY.
A cess-funded fund of funds run by the Ministry of Heavy Industries for EV components.
A production subsidy administered by the RBI under the Payment and Settlement Systems Act.
A component of the Semicon India programme limited to display fabrication.

explanation: MPMS is a Rs 62,500 crore, five-year (FY 2026–27 to 2030–31) successor to the PLI for large-scale electronics, notified by MeitY; it shifts emphasis toward value addition and design.
subject: Current Affairs

question: With reference to the Supreme Court's nine-judge Bench judgment of August 2026 in *State of Uttar Pradesh v. Jai Bir Singh* on the meaning of "industry", consider the following statements:
statements: It was decided by a 5:4 majority.
It held that the "triple test" laid down in *Bangalore Water Supply & Sewerage Board v. A. Rajappa* (1978) will continue to govern pending disputes under the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947.
It held that Section 2(p) of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020 must be interpreted independently of *Bangalore Water Supply*.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: the 5:4 verdict held the 1978 *Bangalore Water Supply* "triple test" governs pending Industrial Disputes Act cases, while Section 2(p) of the Industrial Relations Code, 2020 is to be read independently.
subject: Current Affairs

question: In August 2026, UPI completed a milestone widely reported in the press. Consider the following statements:
statements: UPI completed ten years since its launch.
It is operated by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).
It was recognised as the world's largest real-time payments system.
tail: Which of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: UPI completed ten years, is run by NPCI, and was recognised as the world's largest real-time payments system.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The 'Chennai Declaration', adopted this week, relates to which of the following?

options.text: A G20 outcome document on debt restructuring
A BRICS ministerial declaration on science, technology and innovation
A Quad statement on critical and emerging technologies
An ASEAN–India declaration on the digital economy

explanation: The Chennai Declaration was a BRICS declaration on science, technology and innovation, adopted under India's 2026 BRICS chairship.
subject: Current Affairs

question: With reference to the Adi Vaani platform launched in August 2026, consider the following statements:
statements: It is an AI-based translation platform for tribal languages, launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs.
Santali is the only tribal language currently included in the Eighth Schedule of the Constitution.
Santali was added to the Eighth Schedule by the 92nd Constitutional Amendment Act, 2003.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: Adi Vaani is the Ministry of Tribal Affairs' AI tribal-language translator; Santali is the only tribal language in the Eighth Schedule, added by the 92nd Amendment Act, 2003 (alongside Bodo, Dogri and Maithili).
subject: Current Affairs

question: With reference to the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) summit being hosted in 2026, consider the following statements:
statements: The Heads of State Council summit is being held at Bishkek.
Kyrgyzstan holds the SCO Chairmanship for 2026.
The 2026 summit marks the 25th anniversary of the grouping.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: the summit is at Bishkek, Kyrgyzstan chairs the SCO in 2026, and it marks the grouping's 25th anniversary.
subject: Current Affairs

question: With reference to Census 2027, consider the following statements:
statements: Ladakh and designated snow-bound tracts begin house-to-house Population Enumeration ahead of the rest of India.
It will be the first Census in independent India to enumerate caste as a statutory column.
The Census is conducted by the Registrar General and Census Commissioner of India, an office under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: Ladakh enumerates first, Census 2027 is the first statutory Census in independent India with a caste column, and it is run by the Registrar General & Census Commissioner under the MHA.
subject: Current Affairs

question: The Russian–Indian Roundtable on Snow Leopard Study and Conservation held in Moscow in August 2026 is significant chiefly because it was organised within the institutional framework of:

options.text: The International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA), an India-headquartered body
The Global Snow Leopard and Ecosystem Protection Programme (GSLEP)

explanation: The roundtable operated within the framework of the International Big Cat Alliance (IBCA) — an India-headquartered body — its first major bilateral outing with Russia.
subject: Current Affairs

question: With reference to INS Nipun, in the news in August 2026, consider the following statements:
statements: It is the second Nistar-class Diving Support Vessel of the Indian Navy.
It was indigenously designed and built by Hindustan Shipyard Limited, Visakhapatnam.
tail: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?

subject: Current Affairs

question: With reference to the Vernacular Press Act, 1878, consider the following statements:
statements: It was enacted during the viceroyalty of Lord Lytton.
It made a discriminatory distinction between the English-language and the vernacular press.
It was repealed by Lord Ripon in 1882.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: the Vernacular Press Act (1878) was enacted under Lytton, discriminated against the vernacular press, and was repealed by Ripon in 1882.
subject: Modern History

question: At the Surat session of the Indian National Congress (1907), which ended in the split between Moderates and Extremists, who was elected President of the session?
explanation: Rash Behari Ghosh was the Moderate-backed President at Surat (1907); Tilak, from the host province, could not preside, and the split followed.
subject: Modern History

question: With reference to the foundation of the Indian National Congress, consider the following statements:
statements: It was founded in 1885 with A.O. Hume playing a leading organising role.
Its first session was held at Bombay under the presidency of W.C. Bonnerjee.
The first session was attended by 72 delegates.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: INC founded 1885, first session at Bombay under W.C. Bonnerjee, with 72 delegates; A.O. Hume was the key organiser.
subject: Modern History

question: Consider the following pairs of the Home Rule Movement (1916):
tail: | Home Rule League | Founder | |---|---| | 1. Indian Home Rule League | Bal Gangadhar Tilak | | 2. Home Rule League | Annie Besant | Which of the pairs given above is/are correctly matched?

question: Consider the following pairs of Gandhi's early satyagrahas (1917–1918) and their immediate cause:
tail: | Satyagraha | Immediate cause | |---|---| | 1. Champaran | Indigo cultivation under the Tinkathia system | | 2. Kheda | Peasants' demand for remission of land revenue after crop failure | | 3. question: With reference to the Lucknow Pact of 1916, consider the following statements:
statements: It was an agreement between the Indian National Congress and the All-India Muslim League.
Through it, the Congress accepted the principle of separate electorates for Muslims.
tail: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
explanation: Both correct: the Lucknow Pact (1916) was a Congress–Muslim League agreement in which the Congress accepted separate electorates for Muslims.
subject: Modern History

question: With reference to the Poona Pact (1932), consider the following statements:
statements: It was concluded between M.K. Gandhi and B.R. Ambedkar.
It did away with the separate electorates for the Depressed Classes that had been granted by the Communal Award.
In their place, it provided reserved seats for the Depressed Classes within the general electorate.
tail: How many of the statements given above are correct?
explanation: All three: the Poona Pact (1932) between Gandhi and Ambedkar replaced the Communal Award's separate electorates for the Depressed Classes with reserved seats within the general electorate.
subject: Modern History
